- Total revenue TW was £157.7k versus £179.0k LW, a WoW change of -11.9%.

- United Kingdom ranked 1 TW with £117.3k, a 74.4% share of total TW revenue.
- United Kingdom revenue fell -30.4% WoW TW, a decline of £51.1k versus LW.
- Netherlands ranked 2 TW with £18.0k and an 11.4% share, up 1,414.9% WoW, or £16.8k versus LW.
- EIRE ranked 3 TW with £9.2k and a 5.9% share, taking the top three to 91.6% of TW revenue.
- France revenue rose 568.6% WoW TW and Germany rose 4.0% WoW TW.
- United Kingdom led volume TW with 66,459 units and 314 orders, the highest of any country.
